notes: Approach to skills teaching: B Lessons  Lessons B and D focus on development of one of the four skills: reading, listening, writing, or speaking. For each skill, the Exam practice offers a number of generic exam task types commonly found in international exams for the relevant level, including Cambridge and TOEFL®, all of which help students gain confidence ahead of their exams. notes: Task-based Learning (TBL) is an English teaching approach that has roots in the Communicative Language Teaching method, where the teaching process is done entirely through communicative tasks. In order to fully acquire language, it must have real meaning by being used in natural contexts. With Task-based Learning, teachers ask students to complete purposeful tasks that elicit the use of the target language. Assessment centers around the general outcome of the task, rather than meticulously picking apart each element of speech. In doing this, you celebrate the successful, appropriate completion of a task, which in turn boosts student confidence immensely. ontesol.com Teachers can analyze a Best finish task  58

notes: Mediation in ELT is defined in the  CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)  as the act of taking content and rephrasing it to suit a different context, enabling learners to act as social agents who create bridges and help convey meaning  grade-university.com+1 . It goes beyond simple interaction by focusing on  making meaning accessible  and overcoming linguistic or cultural barriers  The Council of Europe . Mediation can occur  within the same language ( intralinguistic )  or  between different languages (interlinguistic)   Textual Mediation : Involves summarizing, translating, or explaining written or spoken texts to make them understandable for others. Skills include note-taking, paraphrasing, and expressing personal responses  grade-university.com+1 . Conceptual Mediation : Facilitates understanding of ideas or concepts, often through collaborative discussion or problem-solving tasks  grade-university.com . Communication Mediation : Helps manage interactions in social, cultural, or delicate situations, ensuring effective communication in pluricultural contexts  grade-university.com+1 . Have teachers use a mediation task from any unit and identify the type of mediation. Also, skills and subskills to be developed.  59
